requirements.text: - At least 5 years of experience as a software engineer, with a focus on full stack web development.
- Expertise with modern frameworks such as React, Node.js, Typescript, and related tooling.
- Strong in at least one of: Node.js, Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, or Ruby on Rails.
- Strong knowledge of system design, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services (especially AWS/Fargate).
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

The position is based in the company’s office in San Francisco. All of the company’s engineers work in the office 5 days/week, and it seeks candidates who will be excited about working in a fast-paced, hard-working, high-performance environment where teammates are together in person.
- Passion for healthcare, wellness, or longevity tech.
- Experience at an early-stage startup or as a founding engineer.

Skyrocket Ventures is a recruiting firm for hundreds of high growth technology companies that range from industry leaders to top-tier startups. This opportunity is with one of our client companies for a full-time permanent hire. Please only apply if you are authorized to work in the U.S.
